findings.summary: The doc comment says the hook runs 'once per non-override admission', but the code calls it whenever it is supplied, including when soulAlignmentOverride is set. In that case labelSoulAlignment holds the override (baseSoulAlignment is computed from override ?? label), not the label-table value as the field doc claims. Either guard on !options?.soulAlignmentOverride or correct the comments.

findings.summary: The fire-and-forget promise swallows errors silently when onError is not provided. If onError itself throws, the .catch handler rejects with nothing downstream, which becomes an unhandled rejection. Wrap the onError call in try/catch, or default it to a no-op safe logger.
